frequency_question: How often does an executive nominee proceed from nomination to confirmed floor vote within a 56-day window when historical precursor signals are in the current state?
membership_rule: Cabinet and major agency head nominations (e.g., FDA, CDC, EPA, cabinet secretaries) submitted to the U.S. Senate where a confirmation vote occurred or failed to occur within 56 days of initial tracking.

cases.name: Marty Makary / FDA-like recent nominees baseline
Meghan Ryan (hypothetical stalled health agency nomination)

coverage_note: 5 named cases representing recent polarized Senate confirmation timelines for health/regulatory agency heads.
known_gaps: Excludes recess appointments and un-voted withdrawals that happened prior to committee hearings.
skeleton: Recent congressional terms (116th to 118th Congresses) examining executive agency confirmations within 60 days of formal committee action.
validity_reason: Tied to the current composition and procedural norms of the U.S. Senate, which resets with each new Congress.
